description: Emily Tseffos is a mom, educator, and community organizer running for Wisconsin State Senate in District 19. She’s focused on lowering costs for families, supporting kids in our schools and communities, and making our neighborhoods safer through practical, people-first solutions. Learn more, get involved, and help build a Wisconsin that works for all of us.
